opening.argument: The video presents a conventional beauty-channel giveaway centered on a $50 Ulta gift card, with entry tied to ordinary audience actions rather than payment or investment. The listed conditions require subscribing to the channel, subscribing to a second channel, liking a Facebook page, and leaving a comment about a favorite makeup item and shade. The selection is expressly described as random, while the request for an address is connected to sending the prize to the selected recipient and accompanied by an age or parental-permission condition. The offer is limited to the United States, and the available evidence identifies no investment offer, payment requirement, credential request, or deceptive outcome. These features establish a routine rewards and promotion mechanism, not a harmful solicitation.

citations.quote: Leave a comment telling me your favorite makeup item & your favorite shade of it
Must be over 18 or have parents permission since i will be needing your address to send it to you
